title: Welcome to the Moon
subtitle: Evolving Flip-and-Write Narrative Space Campaign
tagline: Save humanity across 8 sequential, evolving lunar adventures from Earth liftoff to permanent colonization.
loreSummary: Earth is running out of time. As the chief flight planner, lead humanity's daring lunar evacuation across 8 unique, evolving dry-erase adventure boards. Flip construction cards, manage spaceship systems, drill subterranean ice caves, and establish the Moon's first thriving utopian metropolis.
keyFeatures: The culminating installment of the acclaimed Welcome to... flip-and-write board game series
8 completely distinct, progressive adventure boards with evolving rules, mechanisms, and scoring
Rich narrative campaign book with branching story paragraphs, missions, and persistent unlocks
Solo Astra campaign mode or simultaneous group play for up to 6 players

welcome_moon_full_odyssey.name: The Lunar Odyssey Campaign (All 8 Adventures)
welcome_moon_full_odyssey.description: The full campaign book experience playing through each of the 8 progressive lunar adventures three times to resolve narrative choices.

welcome_moon_direct_flight.name: Direct Flight Arc (Adventures 1–8)
welcome_moon_direct_flight.description: A streamlined linear sequence playing through each of the 8 distinct lunar boards once in chronological story order.

welcome_moon_master_colonizer.name: Master Lunar Colonizer (Full Campaign & Astra Variants)
welcome_moon_master_colonizer.description: An exhaustive campaign marathon exploring every alternative story path, maximum difficulty milestones, and solo Astra bots.

milestones.title: Liftoff from Earth
milestones.description: Flipping construction cards to fuel rocket stages and break Earth's gravitational orbit.

milestones.title: Lunar Descent & Landing
milestones.description: Maneuvering thrusters and establishing the first pressurized lunar base pads inside craters.

milestones.title: The Subterranean Water Dome
milestones.description: Pumping ice lakes and connecting greenhouse conduits to sustain growing lunar communities.

milestones.title: The Alien Virus Quarantine
milestones.phase: Act IV - Crisis in the Biosphere
milestones.description: Isolating infected sectors and synthesizing anti-pathogen vaccines in the high-tech lab.

milestones.title: The Independent Moon Republic
milestones.description: Completing the final utopian megastructure, securing self-sufficiency, and writing humanity's lunar constitution.
